Package dayplanner

Class DayPlannerUtils

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.DayPlannerUtils
public class DayPlannerUtils extends Object
Provides shared helpers for activity category parsing, greeting generation, username storage, and search filtering. Methods are static so callers can use them without creating a utility instance.

      public static String getUsername(String dirName, String fileName, Input keyboard)

    • flushUsername

      public static void flushUsername(String dirName, String fileName)
      Deletes the stored username file if it exists. This is used by the hidden maintenance command; it does not prompt for or create a replacement name.
      Parameters:

    • matchesCriteria

      public static boolean matchesCriteria(Activity act, ActivityType type, Time searchStart, Time searchEnd)

      Determines whether an activity satisfies the specified search criteria.

      All non-null criteria must be satisfied simultaneously:

      • searchStart: the activity's start time must be >= searchStart.
      • searchEnd: the activity's end time must be <= searchEnd.

      Passing null for any filter disables that filter entirely.

      Parameters:
      act - The activity to test.
      type - If valid ActivityType, then act must be an instance of this type. Value of null indicates to not filter by type.
      searchStart - Minimum start time, or null for open start.
      searchEnd - Maximum end time, or null for open end.
      Returns:
      true if the activity satisfies all given criteria, false otherwise.

    • readTimePeriod

      public static Time[] readTimePeriod(Input keyboard)
      Prompts the user for a time period filter and parses the start and end times. A blank response means both bounds are open; a single hyphen may introduce either one-sided range, for example 2026/09/12 06:00 -.
      Parameters:
      keyboard - Input instance to use to prompt the user
      Returns:
      A two-element array {searchStart, searchEnd}; either element may be null to represent an open bound.
